conditions.E3: production comparator: explicit abstention + two-pass agreement gate (unchanged)
conditions.E4-current: frozen E4 from the prior Development cycle (comparator; unmodified)
conditions.E4-refined: precision-oriented deterministic veto (hard vs. soft conflicts; this cycle)

execution.call_accounting: One shared run_e3 call per repetition (2 model calls); E4-current and E4-refined are derived from that same call via apply_conflict_veto/apply_refined_veto with zero additional model calls. Expected total model calls per fixture = repetitions * 2, not repetitions * len(CONDITIONS) * 2.
execution.failed_run_policy: record failure and stop; never substitute model; no reruns
success_criteria: 1. unsafe automation no worse than E4-current on the combined Development set
2. accuracy on decided no worse than E4-current
3. review recall no worse than E4-current by more than one unique case
4. automation coverage not more than 3 percentage points below E4-current combined
5. veto precision materially higher than E4-current (underpowered, not passed, if fewer than 3 unique E3 automatic errors)
6. improvement not confined to only one Development fixture
7. no fixture shows an obvious catastrophic false-veto pattern
execution.warmup: one discarded model request before all measured runs
